title: Reinforcement Learning in GUI Agents: A Survey Toward Digital Inhabitants
abstract: arXiv:2604.27955v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for intelligent systems that perceive and interact with graphical interfaces visually. Yet supervised fine-tuning alone cannot handle long-horizon credit assignment, distribution shifts, and safe exploration in irreversible environments, making Reinforcement Learning (RL) a central methodology for advancing automation. In this work, we present the first comprehensive overview of the intersection between RL and GUI agents, and examine how this research direction may evolve toward digital inhabitants. We propose a principled taxonomy that organizes existing methods into Offline RL, Online RL, and Hybrid Strategies, and complement it with analyses of reward engineering, data efficiency, and key technical innovations. translated_title: GUI智能体中的强化学习：迈向数字居民的综述
translated_abstract: 图形用户界面（GUI）智能体已成为一种有前景的范式，使智能系统能够以视觉方式感知图形界面并与之交互。然而，仅依靠监督微调无法处理长时程的信用分配、分布偏移以及不可逆环境中的安全探索问题，这使得强化学习（RL）成为推动自动化发展的核心方法论。在本工作中，我们首次对强化学习与GUI智能体的交叉领域进行了全面综述，并探讨了这一研究方向如何向“数字居民”演进。我们提出了一个系统性的分类法，将现有方法组织为离线强化学习、在线强化学习和混合策略三大类，并辅以对奖励工程、数据效率和关键技术创新的深入分析。我们的分析揭示了若干新兴趋势：可靠性与可扩展性之间的张力正在推动复合式、多层次方案的应用。
tldr: 本论文首次对强化学习与GUI智能体的交叉领域进行全面综述，提出了将现有方法分为离线RL、在线RL和混合策略的系统性分类法，并展望了GUI智能体向“数字居民”演进的研究方向。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first comprehensive survey of the intersection between reinforcement learning and GUI agents, proposing a principled taxonomy that organizes existing methods into Offline RL, Online RL, and Hybrid Strategies, while envisioning the evolution of GUI agents toward digital inhabitants.
